memories.content: On 2026-08-12 Mara submitted her application for the permanent ICU position at the General, with references from Dr. Halloran and Priya; an interview was expected later that month.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: Toronto General Hospital, where Mara applied for the permanent ICU position

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's friend and fellow ICU nurse; distinct from manager Priyanka

memories.content: In her application Mara wrote (2026-08-12) that she wants to help fix the staffing from inside the institution rather than flee it.

Priya holds the view (relayed 2026-08-12) that the institution is a lost cause and she would 'burn it down'; Mara agrees management has been bad but disagrees, believing it is fixable and wanting to 'renovate.' Two distinct holders of an overlapping grievance.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's friend and fellow ICU nurse who thinks the institution is unfixable; distinct from manager Priyanka

memories.content: Mara's interview for the permanent ICU position was expected later in August 2026 (noted 2026-08-12).
Mara hit send on the permanent-position application before she could talk herself out of it, and felt settled but a little terrified (2026-08-12).
